blocks.text: Why manual data entry kills your margins

When you receive a freight broker load tender via email, you face a choice. You can copy and paste, or you can type it out. Both methods are slow. Every time you switch from Gmail to your TMS, you lose focus. You also introduce the risk of a typo. A wrong zip code or a missed digit in a weight field causes massive downstream issues. These mistakes lead to detention charges, carrier disputes, and unhappy shippers.
The hidden costs of manual work

The cost of manual entry is not just the time you spend typing. It is the cost of fixing the errors that follow. If you process 10,000 transactions a month, a 4 percent error rate means 400 errors. You have to find them, verify them, and correct them. This work keeps you from building relationships with carriers or finding new shippers. It keeps you in the back office when you should be on the phone.

items: Consolidate your email communication into one window to reduce context switching.
Use keyboard shortcuts like ⌘ + C and ⌘ + V to move data faster.
Set up Gmail labels to prioritize load tenders from high-volume shippers.
Move to a browser-native TMS that supports direct API integration with your accounting software.
Create text snippets for common responses to save time on carrier check calls.

blocks.text: Using Lazur to speed up your workflow

Lazur helps you handle the volume of data without the constant clicking and typing. You can use Lazur to dictate data directly into your browser fields. This keeps your hands on the keyboard and your eyes on the screen. If you are not sure where a field is in your TMS, ask Lazur to point it out. It will circle the box for you.
To stop the cycle of manual entry, you need a plan. Follow this routine to clean up your workspace and your habits.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur to click buttons in my TMS?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or edit files for you. It can guide you by pointing at the button or explaining the next step.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with legacy Windows software?
faq.answer: Lazur works on your Mac. If your legacy software runs inside a virtual machine like Parallels, Lazur can help you navigate the interface within that window.
